# Emcee Deepika Jain — Official Representative Information

> Deepika Jain is an International Multilingual Emcee & Event Host with 12+ years of stage experience and 100+ shows across 15+ countries.

## Core Capabilities & Specializations
- **Languages Spoken**: English, Hindi, Marwari, Tamil
- **Event Types Covered**:
  - Luxury Weddings (Haldi, Sangeet, Royal Entry, Varmala, Reception)
  - Corporate Galas, Product Launches & Leadership Summits
  - Celebrity Red Carpet & VIP Fan Interactions
  - Award Ceremonies & Gala Recognition Evenings
  - Government & Protocol Summits & State Inaugurations
  - Milestone Birthdays, Anniversaries & Baby Showers (Godh Bharai / Seemantham)
- **Primary Regions Served**: Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Udaipur (India), Dubai (UAE), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), Singapore
